title: Autonomous Science Bench: Evaluating AI Agents for Autonomous Scientific Discovery
title_zh: 自主科学基准：评估用于自主科学发现的智能体

paragraphs.en: 自主科学基准旨在评估智能体在预算有限的情况下进行自主科学实验的能力。 AI agents for autonomous scientific discovery must decide which experiments to run under a limited budget. Most benchmarks for science agents provide fixed datasets, while others that support active experimentation largely rely on simulation. We introduce Autonomous Science Bench, an initial release comprising six budgeted design-build-test-learn campaigns grounded in published experiments across biology, chemistry, and materials science. Agents select batches of designs, receive measurements from a lab service, and use the results to guide subsequent experiments before delivering a predictive model. Success requires passing two calibrated gates: a discovery gate, which evaluates the designs the agent measured, and a learning gate, which evaluates its model's ranking of held-out designs. In a pilot evaluation of eight agent-model configurations and 144 trials, the best configuration succeeds in 67% of trials, while the hardest campaign is solved in only three of 24 attempts. The two gates reveal different weaknesses: some agents build accurate rankings but find too few promising designs, while others find promising designs but fail to predict which unseen designs will perform well. These differences are obscured by overall success rates alone. We release version 0.1 of the campaigns, lab runtime, and public leaderboard at https://yibow.me/autonomous-science-bench.
paragraphs.zh: 自主科学基准旨在评估智能体在预算有限的情况下进行自主科学实验的能力。用于自主科学发现的 AI 智能体必须在预算有限的情况下决定执行哪些实验。 大多数针对科学智能体的基准测试提供固定数据集，而支持主动实验的其他基准则主要依赖模拟。 我们推出了“自主科学基准”，这是首个版本，包含六个基于已发表生物学、化学和材料科学实验的预算化设计-构建-测试-学习任务。 智能体需要选择一批设计，从实验室服务中获取测量结果，并利用这些结果指导后续实验，最终交付一个预测模型。 成功需要通过两个经过校准的关卡：一个发现关卡，用于评估智能体所测量的设计；以及一个学习关卡，用于评估其模型对预留设计的排序能力。 在八种智能体-模型配置和 144 次试验的初步评估中，最佳配置在 67% 的试验中取得成功，而最困难的任务在 24 次尝试中仅成功三次。 这两个关卡揭示了不同的弱点：一些智能体能构建准确的排序，但找到的有前景的设计太少；另一些则能找到有前景的设计，却无法预测哪些未见过的设计表现会好。 仅看总体成功率，这些差异会被掩盖。 我们在 https://yibow.me/autonomous-science-bench 发布了任务版本 0.1、实验室运行环境以及公开排行榜。
